full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white fashion photograph frames a young woman's face at very close range. She looks directly into the camera with large pale eyes, dark lashes, and a composed, almost searching expression. Smooth dark hair is swept diagonally across the forehead and gathered away from the face, leaving one neat line around the temple. Both hands rise to the cheeks, covered in black lace gloves with intricate floral openings. The patterned fabric forms a dark textured frame around the lower face and sides, while the fingers curve inward near the jaw. Her skin is lit evenly and appears luminous in cool silvery tones; subtle freckles and small shifts of texture remain visible on the cheeks and nose. The lips are softly closed and much less emphatic than the wide eyes. A pale gray background provides little spatial context, keeping the face, hair, and lace as the only strong elements. Light is broad and frontal, with gentle shadows around the glove folds and beneath the chin rather than sharp directional modeling. The deep black gloves and glossy hair contrast with the light skin and gray backdrop. The camera crop cuts close to the top hairline and shoulders, making the gaze unavoidable. Fine tonal gradations and precise focus preserve the difference between translucent lace, smooth skin, and sleek hair. The composition is symmetrical in broad shape, but slight asymmetry in the hands and hair keeps it alive. The image is restrained and elegant, using texture, framing, and direct eye contact rather than elaborate setting or action.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白时尚摄影极近距离框住一名年轻女子的面孔。她直视镜头，有浅亮大眼、深睫毛和沉着、几乎像在探问的表情。平滑深发从额前斜扫并收向脸外，在鬓边留下整齐线条。双手举到双颊，戴着有精细花形镂空的黑蕾丝手套。花纹布料在脸下方和两侧形成深而有质地的边框，手指向内弯到下颌附近。肌肤受均匀光线照亮，呈发亮的冷银色调；脸颊和鼻子仍有细微雀斑及质地变化。嘴唇柔和闭合，远不如睁大的眼睛醒目。浅灰背景几乎不给空间信息，使面孔、头发和蕾丝成为唯一有力元素。光宽泛而从正面来，阴影温和地留在手套褶层与下巴下方，而非尖锐的方向性塑形。深黑手套和发亮头发对照浅肤与灰底。相机紧贴上方发际和肩部裁切，让目光不可回避。细致色调渐变和精确焦点保留透空蕾丝、平滑肌肤与整齐头发的区别。构图大体对称，但双手与头发的轻微不对称让它鲜活。图像克制而优雅，依靠纹理、框景与直接对视，而非复杂环境或动作。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white fashion photography uses a very close frontal crop, direct eye contact, and contrasting tactile materials. Broad soft light gives skin luminous silver midtones while deep hair and lace provide richly textured blacks. Keep fine pattern openings, lashes, and small skin details sharp against a quiet pale ground. A nearly symmetrical hand-built frame can concentrate attention on a central gaze; slight irregularity prevents stiffness. Shadows remain gentle and local, with no hard studio spotlight. The finish is polished, restrained, and materially precise.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白时尚摄影使用极近的正面裁切、直接对视和相反的可触材质。宽泛柔光使肌肤呈发亮银色中间调，深发与蕾丝提供纹理丰富的黑色。细花纹镂空、睫毛与小皮肤细节在安静浅底前保持锐利。近乎对称、由双手建成的边框可将注意力集中于中央目光；细小不规则避免僵硬。阴影保持温和局部，没有坚硬影棚聚光。完成面精致、克制，材质刻画准确。
theme_en: A close black-and-white fashion portrait with patterned lace gloves framing the face
theme_zh: 黑白时尚面孔近景，花纹蕾丝手套围住脸
name: Mariano Vivanco
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
